big_case.notes: A single-Justice emergency application to vacate a Fifth Circuit stay pending a federal-officer removal appeal in Louisiana coastal-land-loss litigation. The underlying Griggs/Coinbase post-remand automatic-stay question is a real inter-circuit split with national reach for removal practice, but the Court had declined it on cert (City of Brunswick, Oct. 19, 2026) days earlier, and the application concerns forum timing rather than liability. It was denied by the Circuit Justice alone, without referral. Modest stakes.
